questions: Should the scaling factors be applied sequentially (each scaling from the previous scaled image) or collectively (each scaling from the original image)?
What should be the order of dimensions in the resize call: (height, width) or (width, height)? The reference uses (height, width) but PIL's size is (width, height).
Should the function close the matplotlib figures or leave them open for display? The reference creates figures but doesn't close them.
What color mode conversion or handling should be applied? The reference uses raw array; should RGB/grayscale be preserved or normalized?
Is the output list order guaranteed to match the input scale_factors order?
Should the function display images interactively (plt.show) or just create Axes? The reference has plt.show commented out.
What data type should the scaled numpy array have? The reference uses float from skimage.resize.
How should non-integer scaled dimensions be handled? The reference uses int() rounding; is this the required behavior?
